subject: Post-demo: Commercial path, procurement readiness & sample invoice template
messages:
From: lauren_bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>

Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22 09:12 -0800
Subject: Post-demo: Commercial path, procurement readiness & sample invoice template

Hi Marta — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so procurement and billing have what they need to progress: 

- Commercial path: you indicated primary preference for a formal PO (finance prefers vendor invoices) but engineering is open to card for initial pilot.
- Net terms: procurement asked about standard net-30 vs net-45; we typically offer net-30 on enterprise contracts.
- Invoice format: procurement needs line-itemized invoices with SKU mapping, tax/VAT breakouts, and the Redwood order reference (we can include SOW or subscription IDs per invoice).
- Billing address & tax: please confirm legal entity name and VAT ID for Finova Health for our records.
- Marketplace: you mentioned exploring AWS Marketplace for procurement — we can support either direct contract or marketplace listing; marketplace adds a different invoice flow (AWS handles billing).

Attached is a short commercial summary and an example CSV-style invoice template that matches what our billing ops can produce. Can you confirm: (1) who in procurement will accept a Redwood PO? (2) confirm net terms preference (net-30 vs net-45); (3) whether VAT ID or tax paperwork is required up front.

Next steps: if procurement wants a redline or formal quote we can send an official quote and route to procurement contact. Happy to hop on another 15-min call with your AP team to align the format.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference

+1 (415) 555-0119

Attachment: sample_invoice_redwood.csv (CSV, example line items)

From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@finovahealth.com>

Cc: procurement@finovahealth.com, Rajesh Patel <rajesh.patel@finovahealth.com>
Date: 2026-11-22 11:03 -0800
Subject: Re: Post-demo: Commercial path, procurement readiness & sample invoice template

Hi Lauren — thanks for the summary and the attachments. A few clarifying items from procurement and AP: 

1) Preferred path: procurement will prefer PO on Net-30 for production contracts. For a short pilot (less than 3 months) we can do card, but procurement wants to see a pilot acceptance criteria and estimate of expected spend.
2) Invoice format: procurement requires an invoice with: invoice number, invoice date, Redwood order reference, itemized line description, unit price, quantity, line total, subtotal, VAT/Tax line (if applicable), and billing address. PDF or CSV both fine.
3) VAT / Tax: Finova Health (EU subsidiary) has a VAT ID for EU purchases, but US entity purchases are non-VAT. We will need tax jurisdiction indicated on invoices where applicable.
4) Billing address and remit-to: please bill to Finova Health, Inc., 400 Civic Drive, Suite 120, San Mateo, CA 94401. Our AP team uses remit-to fields for automated processing; ETL expects a single-line remit-to and a separate address block.

Could you re-send the sample invoice populated with an example PO number and with the VAT line shown as $0.00 for a US invoice? Also, if you can provide a short note on how marketplace payments change timing and invoicing (AWS marketplace vs direct), that will help us decide.

We can loop in our AP contact if needed; copying procurement here.

Best,
Marta Lopez
Head of Corporate Programs
Finova Health
marta.lopez@finovahealth.com

Thanks Marta — quick answers inline and attached an updated sample PNG/PDF we send to AP: 

- PO path / net terms: confirmed — we can issue invoices on Net-30 for the production contract. For pilots, card is acceptable as Lauren noted; if you expect spend > $10k for pilot we typically recommend a short-commit reserved instance and will provide a draft PO + quote.
- Sample invoice: attached is sample_invoice_redwood.csv populated with a mock PO: FIN-2026-4407 and VAT shown as $0.00 for a US bill. We also included a PDF rendering sample_invoice_redwood.pdf for AP ingestion.
- Marketplace: AWS Marketplace changes routing — AWS bills you and remits to Redwood. That means invoice visibility in your AP system comes from AWS invoices and timing follows AWS payment terms (can delay Redwood receiving payment until AWS settlement windows). If you need line-level Redwood SKUs in your GL, we can provide a monthly breakout report to align with AWS invoices.

If procurement wants a canonical sample to test with their ERP import, happy to provide a flattened CSV with the exact column order your system needs (we can map columns). If you are ready, we can set a quick 20-min call between Redwood billing ops and Finova AP to validate the file format.

Cheers,
Ben Carter

Marissa / Lauren / Ben — thanks for the quick turnaround and the populated samples. Procurement reviewed and we have the following: 

- We will proceed with PO (FIN-2026-4407) on Net-30 for the initial production pilot once we finalize SOW acceptance criteria. Please issue a formal quote and the invoice once PO is referenced.
- VAT: US invoices will show $0.00 as you provided. For EU transactions we'll request your EU entity details before we finalize tax treatment.
- Marketplace: procurement prefers direct invoicing for now (simplifies reconciliation). We may revisit AWS Marketplace later for longer-term procurement.
- Next step: can you send an official quote (PDF) with the line items, unit prices, and the mock PO populated as the PO reference? Also send a short one-pager on pilot acceptance criteria so procurement can sign off.

Looping in procurement — thanks for the help.
